"""Zrzut karty i Logów, gdy sam rdzeń (run_process) rzuci wyjątek: droga ``core is None`` ostatniej siatki."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

import pytest

from rozliczenia.centrum import runs
from tests.test_centrum_logi_uruchomienia import records
from tests.fixtures.centrum_processes import preparing_centrum, run_to_end, settling_centrum

OUT = Path(os.environ["K6_OUT"])
VOLATILE = {"run_id", "started_at", "ended_at", "tool", "environment", "file_name"}


def _scrub(value: Any) -> Any:
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {k: ("<v>" if k in VOLATILE else _scrub(v)) for k, v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [_scrub(v) for v in value]
    return value


@pytest.mark.parametrize(("key", "centrum_of", "dry_run"), [
    ("rozliczenia-podglad", settling_centrum, True), ("rozliczenia-zapis", settling_centrum, False),
    ("przygotowanie-podglad", preparing_centrum, True), ("przygotowanie-zapis", preparing_centrum, False),
])
def test_zrzut(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch, key: str, centrum_of: Any, dry_run: bool) -> None:
    centrum = centrum_of(tmp_path)

    def broken(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        raise ValueError("synthetic core failure SYN-002")

    monkeypatch.setattr(runs, "run_process", broken)
    view = run_to_end(centrum, dry_run=dry_run)
    [record] = records(centrum)
    trace = record.get("trace")
    if trace:
        record["trace"] = {"exception_type": trace.get("exception_type"), "frames": len(trace.get("frames", []))}
    lines = [line.split(" ", 2)[-1] for line in centrum.log_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (OUT / f"{key}.json").write_text(
        json.dumps({"card": _scrub(view["result"]), "log": _scrub(record), "dziennik": lines}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1, sort_keys=True),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
EOF
